invariants: availability executes after committed state and false panes remain logically open
callback and render failures quarantine one registration identity and restore the built-in files role
a same-key reload is fresh authority and cannot inherit quarantine, pending retention, or a drag
retired pane controls cannot mutate state and authorized side-pane opens reveal responsive space
current-line panes remain mounted only while the exact previously accepted registration waits for fresh paint
responsive fractions remain automatic until a drag creates an axis-tagged override
right and bottom drags invert pointer movement and terminal shrink cancels stale ownership

nativeAdaptation.lifecycle: ExtensionPaneControllerState owns the state React hooks and layout effects owned upstream.
nativeAdaptation.mouse: Boolean ownership results replace OpenTUI preventDefault and stopPropagation calls; Crossterm dispatch consumes claimed events.
nativeAdaptation.availability: workdeck/pane/available is a deadline-bounded JSON-RPC request returning one strict boolean.
